scope: All original mlp-b4 and mlp-b8 budgets; strict peak improvements and exact computational closure. Complete fixed-memory work functions for both MLPs, including all integer caps and zero-work tails; auxiliary points are not extra original benchmark cases.
method: Exact minimum-extra-forward-work Dijkstra at a fixed memory cap, specialized to strict immediate-parent chains; a generic unnormalized implementation cross-checks each exclusion cap.
first_falsifier: Fully charge mlp-b4 at the favorable mandatory local cap of 36,864 bytes before larger constructions.
success_test: Unchanged verifier accepts a lower-peak certificate at an original budget, or complete finite search excludes every smaller peak.
overlap: Working targets include all 17 trial improvements. Trial policies and PR 6 retention-transfer exact/regional work are positive controls and credited, not rediscovered as gains.
authorization: Local isolated package only; parent coordinates publication. No core, frozen graph, verifier, or frontier edits.
